#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int INF = INT_MAX / 100;

struct MinCostMaxFlow {
    struct Edge {
        int to, flow, cost, rev;
        Edge(int t, int f, int c, int r) : to(t), flow(f), cost(c), rev(r) {}
    };
    int N, S, T, maxFlow, minCost;
    vector<vector<Edge>> graph;
    vector<vector<Edge>> edges; // after conversion from adjacency list
    vector<int> dist, prevNode, prevEdge;

    MinCostMaxFlow(int n, int s, int t) : N(n), S(s), T(t), maxFlow(0), minCost(0) {
        graph.resize(N);
    }

    void addEdge(int u, int v, int flow, int cost) {
        int lu = graph[u].size(), lv = graph[v].size();
        graph[u].emplace_back(v, flow, cost, lv);
        graph[v].emplace_back(u, 0, -cost, lu);
    }

    void convertToArray() {
        edges = graph;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) graph[i].clear();
    }

    bool bellmanFord() {
        dist.assign(N, INF);
        prevNode.assign(N, -1);
        prevEdge.assign(N, -1);
        dist[S] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < N - 1; ++i) {
            bool updated = false;
            for (int u = 0; u < N; ++u) {
                if (dist[u] == INF) continue;
                for (int e = 0; e < (int)edges[u].size(); ++e) {
                    Edge &edge = edges[u][e];
                    if (edge.flow == 0) continue;
                    int v = edge.to;
                    int nd = dist[u] + edge.cost;
                    if (nd < dist[v]) {
                        dist[v] = nd;
                        prevNode[v] = u;
                        prevEdge[v] = e;
                        updated = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!updated) break;
        }
        return dist[T] != INF;
    }

    int augment() {
        int p = T, minFlow = INF;
        while (p != S) {
            int u = prevNode[p], e = prevEdge[p];
            minFlow = min(minFlow, edges[u][e].flow);
            p = u;
        }
        p = T;
        while (p != S) {
            int u = prevNode[p], e = prevEdge[p];
            edges[u][e].flow -= minFlow;
            int rev = edges[u][e].rev;
            edges[p][rev].flow += minFlow;
            p = u;
        }
        maxFlow += minFlow;
        return minFlow;
    }

    void calBellmanFord() {
        while (bellmanFord()) {
            minCost += dist[T] * augment();
        }
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    int maxl = n + k;
    int T = n * maxl + 1;
    MinCostMaxFlow mcmf(T + 1, 0, T);

    vector<int> a(k + 1), f(n + 1, 0);
    for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
        cin >> a[i];
        f[a[i]]++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        if (f[i] == 0) continue;
        mcmf.addEdge(0, i, f[i], 0);
    }
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; ++l) {
            mcmf.addEdge(l * n + i, (l + 1) * n + i, k, c);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        int a, b;
        cin >> a >> b;
        for (int l = 0; l < maxl - 1; ++l) {
            for (int p = 1; p <= k; ++p) {
                if (a != 1)
                    mcmf.addEdge(n * l + a, n * (l + 1) + b, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
                if (b != 1)
                    mcmf.addEdge(n * l + b, n * (l + 1) + a, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c);
            }
        }
    }
    for (int l = 1; l < maxl; ++l) {
        mcmf.addEdge(l * n + 1, T, k, 0);
    }
    mcmf.convertToArray();
    mcmf.calBellmanFord();

    if (mcmf.maxFlow != k) {
        cout << "BUG\n";
    } else {
        cout << (int)mcmf.minCost << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}
